remarks: One floor living just minutes from downtown New Canaan! Located close to the Merritt Parkway, shopping, restaurants and train. This two bedroom unit is on the first floor of a two-family home and includes 2 off-street tandem driveway parking spaces to the right side of the driveway. Ample storage, newer full bathroom with tub, updated kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances including a professional grade gas stove, dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator and washer/dryer. Hardwood floors throughout living room, dine-in kitchen and 2 bedrooms. Primary bedroom includes walk-in closet. Level, shared, fully fenced-in backyard in addition to private terrace off kitchen. This rental has it all and pets are welcome! Tenant responsible for credit check, application, rental insurance, all utilities including heat (propane), electricity, cable/internet. 1st months rent and 2 months security (1 month if 62 or older) at signing of the lease. Landlord reserves the right to meet potential tenant/s. Good credit a must.
